artifact.reason: Root component to integrate AppLayout wrapper. Currently uses BrowserRouter and AppRoutes.
Route configuration with paths: /, /guide, /downloads, /devices, /support. Header navigation must use these paths.
LogPanel must connect to this store for logs display. Provides log(), clear() actions and logs state.
Language toggle must use setLanguage() action. Provides language, showWizard state with localStorage persistence.
Reusable Button component for Header settings button, Sidebar collapse button, LogPanel clear button.
Class name utility for combining Tailwind classes. Required for all layout components.
Linear Violet theme colors. Layout components should use color-background, color-sidebar, color-border, etc.
Already syncs i18next with settingsStore. Language toggle should update store, not i18next directly.

constraints.constraint: Layout components must go in src/components/layout/ directory
Use CSS Grid with grid-cols-[260px_1fr_320px] for 3-column layout
Follow Component Pattern: hooks at top, derived state, handlers, render
Use cn() utility for class merging
Import order: React, third-party, stores, hooks, components, types, utils
Header must be fixed at top with dark background
LogPanel colors: info=gray, success=green, warning=yellow, error=red
Log format: [HH:mm:ss] Message with monospace font
Responsive: Full 3-column on 1280px+, collapsible sidebar on tablet
Use React Router Link for navigation, not anchor tags
Install lucide-react for icons: npm install lucide-react

interface.name: useTerminalStore
interface.signature: useTerminalStore(): { logs: TerminalLogEntry[], log: (level, message, data?) => void, clear: () => void }

interface.name: useSettingsStore
interface.signature: useSettingsStore(): { language: 'en'|'vi', setLanguage: (lang) => void, showWizard: boolean, ... }

interface.name: routeConfig
interface.signature: RouteConfig[] with path, element, label for each route

interface.name: Link
interface.signature: Link from react-router-dom for client-side navigation

interface.name: useTranslation
interface.signature: const { t } = useTranslation() for translated strings
